en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4323 - It is narrated from Ali ibn Mahziyar that he said:
I asked Abu Ja'far al-Thani (as) about the saying of Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious;
"By the night when it covers, and by the day when it appears" (Surah Al-Lail 92:1-2)
and His saying, "By the star when it falls" (Surah An-Najm 53:1), and other similar verses.

Imam (as) said: "Indeed, Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious, may swear by whatever He (swt) wills from His (swt) creation, but His (swt) creation is only permitted to swear by Him (swt), the Almighty and Glorious."
